## Target

Which AI tool, file format, or workflow should Contextarr export to?

## Use Case

What Context Pack content needs to be included?

## Required Boundaries

- [ ] Export is explicit and local.
- [ ] Export does not send data to a hosted service.
- [ ] Export does not execute pack content.
- [ ] Export can honor redaction and `never_export` rules.
